
QUERY-EXAMPLE-MAPPING-STATS
Show Example Mapping coverage statistics across work units

WHEN TO USE
  Use to assess specification quality and identify work units that need more Example Mapping.

USAGE
  fspec query-example-mapping-stats [options]

OPTIONS
  --status <status>
    Filter by status

EXAMPLES
  1. Show EM stats
  $ fspec query-example-mapping-stats
  Work units with Example Mapping: 25/42 (59%)
Total rules: 87
Total examples: 134
Unanswered questions: 12

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec show-work-unit
  fspec add-rule
  fspec add-example
